decisions.reason: The black finish is a low-cost variant of existing drains that follows current bathroom design trends, so keeping the option open costs little while demand is still emerging.
The shower channel has its own page and sits close to the core offer, so it builds on existing production and has a clear role in barrier-free bathrooms, which justifies continued commitment.

Pump-assisted drainage reaches further beyond the core business and its prospects are still uncertain after one year, but it is a valuable option for renovation situations and is cheap to keep while the results come in.
The tileable floor drain is a standard extension of the firm's established range with its own page, and its low carrying cost and fit with installers' needs favour keeping it.
The stainless steel design grate uses the firm's own metalworking strengths and has its own page, so there is no early evidence that its value will not be realized.
